title: Synthesis 9: metabolism forks are routine but by construction; construction audits find hidden source terms; walls must beat an exterior-only slow-D twin; neural-field comets are the new swim-divide base
summary: Since 17:29: pcell-mwall-b42 SIBDH (with its metabolic extension) is established; my fresh-seed reviews replicate selection against the inert marker and per-cell dependence on local feed. Neural-field comets (SIMD, IMD) and Flow-Lenia foragers (IMD) are established in new classes, along with several negatives (lcn worms, r-two56 cog fission, lattice-chem division, evoloop open-endedness). Changes in the reading: local-cut forks are now standard; construction audits find hidden source terms (submitted: the FCH chemoton decay feed, the uptake-cargo Boltzmann partition); walls must beat an exterior-only slow-D twin. Next: a working wall on neural-field comets for SIBMD, IBED in a world whose bodies do not need the resource by construction, and audits that check zero-flux states and source signs.
